model_organism.citation: Germ Cell-Specific Retinoic Acid Receptor α Functions in Germ Cell Organization, Meiotic Integrity, and Spermatogonia (PMID: 30099545)
phenotypes: disorganized germ cell layers in seminiferous tubules, worsening with age
abnormal tubules lacking lumen, with vacuoles and massive germ cell sloughing, similar to Rara-null tubules
impaired synaptonemal complex integrity and meiotic progression
decreased initiation of spermatogenesis from spermatogonial stem cells after busulfan treatment (reduced spermatogonial proliferation)

model_organism.citation: Retinoic acid induces Sertoli cell paracrine signals for spermatogonia differentiation but cell autonomously drives spermatocyte meiosis (PMID: 23012458)
phenotypes: somatic genetic ablations of RA synthesis and signaling in Sertoli cells, including Rara
RARA in Sertoli cells mediates RA effects on differentiation of A aligned into A1 spermatogonia, possibly via Mafb expression
RA-dependent control of Stra8 expression and meiotic initiation in spermatocytes
RA of Sertoli cell origin is essential for spermiation

model_organism.citation: Retinoic acid receptor antagonists for male contraception: current status (PMID: 32671394)
phenotypes: review noting that global Rara knockout validates RARA as a male contraceptive target
RARA activity is indispensable for spermatogenesis
pan-RAR and RARA-selective antagonists (BMS-189453, BMS-189532, BMS-189614) cause reversible spermatogenic disruption in mice

model_organism.citation: The bile acid-activated retinoic acid response in dendritic cells is involved in food allergen sensitization (PMID: 34365653)
phenotypes: RA signaling in DCs is required for food allergen-specific IgE and IgG1 production
bile acid-activated RA signaling promotes DC interferon I signature, OX40L and PDL2 upregulation, and Th2 differentiation

model_organism.citation: Bacterial Quorum Sensing Molecules Promote Allergic Airway Inflammation by Activating the Retinoic Acid Response (PMID: 32622265)
phenotypes: DC-specific Rara knockout diminished the AHL-stimulated type 2 immune response (IgE and IgG1 production)
reduced AHL-driven allergic airway inflammation and Th2 differentiation

biological.citation: Zhang et al. 2015 - MicroRNA-27a Contributes to Rhabdomyosarcoma Cell Proliferation by Suppressing RARA and RXRA (PMID: 25915942)
biological.summary: miR-27a is up-regulated in translocation-positive alveolar RMS cell lines and targets RARA and RXRA. Overexpressing miR-27a increased proliferation and reduced the fraction of cells in G1. This links RARA suppression to cell cycle control.

biological.citation: Clearance of PML/RARA-bound promoters suffice to initiate APL differentiation (PMID: 25258343)
biological.summary: RXRA is a coreceptor of the PML/RARA fusion and promotes its efficient DNA binding. Ablating retinoid X receptors loosens PML/RARA DNA binding and induces terminal differentiation of APL cells ex vivo and in vivo. RXRA sumoylation contributes to PML/RARA-dependent transformation.

biological.citation: FTO Plays an Oncogenic Role in Acute Myeloid Leukemia as a N(6)-Methyladenosine RNA Demethylase (PMID: 28017614)
biological.summary: FTO is an m6A demethylase that regulates RARA and ASB2 mRNA by reducing m6A levels in the transcripts. Through this, FTO inhibits ATRA-induced differentiation of AML cells. FTO is highly expressed in t(15;17)/PML-RARA AMLs.

biological.citation: Functional multiomics reveals genetic and pharmacologic regulation of surface CD38 in multiple myeloma (PMID: 40453054)
biological.summary: Genome-wide CRISPRi screens in myeloma cells confirmed RARA as a known regulator of surface CD38. All-trans retinoic acid specifically upregulated CD38 in the integrated transcriptome and surface proteome data.

biological.citation: Targeting ALDH1A1 to enhance the efficacy of KRAS-targeted therapy through ferroptosis (PMID: 39317105)
biological.summary: ALDH1A1 boosts retinoic acid synthesis and improves RARA function. This contributes to resistance to KRAS inhibitors by counteracting ferroptosis, together with activation of the CREB1/GPX4 pathway.

biological.citation: Dysregulation of the ALDH1A3/PML-RARα axis promotes the progression of acute promyelocytic leukemia (PMID: 41580016)
biological.summary: ALDH1A3 cooperates with MAZ to transcriptionally repress PML-RARα expression, shown by ChIP, luciferase reporter assays and EMSA. PML-RARα in turn increases methylation of the ALDH1A3 promoter and suppresses its expression in APL patients. This reciprocal repression correlates with clinical remission.

biological.citation: Expression and function of PML-RARA in the hematopoietic progenitor cells of Ctsg-PML-RARA mice (PMID: 23056333)
biological.summary: In Ctsg-PML-RARA mice, PML-RARA is expressed in KLS hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells as well as in CMPs, GMPs and promyelocytes. It alters the transcriptional signature of these cells and affects multilineage repopulation, but does not induce promyelocyte self-renewal.

biological.citation: Function of PML-RARA in Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (PMID: 39017850)
biological.summary: The PML-RARA fusion deregulates transcriptional control of RAR targets involved in self-renewal and myeloid differentiation and disrupts PML nuclear bodies. Its target genes are not uniformly repressed; some are upregulated or unchanged. RA and arsenic target the fusion's transcriptional deregulation and its protein stability.

biological.citation: Novel treatment of acute promyelocytic leukemia: As2O3, retinoic acid and retinoid pharmacology (PMID: 24433507)
biological.summary: PML/RARa acts as a strong transcriptional repressor of the RAR complex at RAREs by recruiting N-CoR, SMRT and HDACs. High-dose RA relieves this repression and promotes degradation of the fusion. Wild-type RARa is upregulated and PML nuclear bodies relocalize.

biological.citation: Indeno[1,2,3-cd]pyrene and picene mediate actions via estrogen receptor α signaling pathway in in vitro cell systems, altering gene expression (PMID: 32251684)
biological.summary: In MCF-7 cells, the PAHs indeno[1,2,3-cd]pyrene and picene downregulated RARA among 14 ESR1-regulated genes, as shown by RNA sequencing.
